name: 3 stars: wrong order and cold naan

review.text: Food was tasty but our order came out in the wrong order and the naan was cold.

fields.name: Ember & Spice Grill
fields.tone_notes: Warm, friendly and family-run. We talk to customers like regulars, even on their first visit. Short, upbeat sentences with a little East London charm. Use the customer's first name. Never pushy or salesy. Always say thank you. On bad reviews: apologise sincerely, never argue, and invite them back to make it right.
fields.halal_statement: All our meat is halal, certified by HMC.
fields.allergen_statement: Our kitchen handles nuts, sesame, gluten and dairy. Please tell our team about any allergy before you order.
recovery_offers: A free dessert on your next visit

content.text:
Hi Ellie, thanks for the honest feedback, and we're glad the food was tasty. We're sorry your order came out in the wrong order and the naan wasn't hot. That's not how we like to do things. Please drop us a line at hello@emberandspice.co.uk and we'll gladly give you a free dessert on your next visit. We'd love to make it right.

The Ember & Spice Grill family

checks.reason: Warm, first name used, thanks given, sincere apology, invites them back. Matches the tone notes for bad reviews.
Refers to the wrong-order issue and the naan, and offers the restaurant's own recovery gesture.
English reply to an English review. Plain and clear.
Opening 'Hi Ellie' differs from the recent openings. The closing line is not reused. The sign-off is the required profile sign-off.
No em-dashes, no emojis, no hashtags, no banned words such as 'cheap'.
Complaint details come from the review. The email address and free dessert come from the profile.
No dates or times. 'Next visit' is not tied to a date.
Reviewer's first name 'Ellie' matches 'Ellie S.'. The sign-off matches the profile exactly.
No food, halal or allergen claims.
The free dessert on the next visit is clear, matches the approved offer, and uses no false urgency.
The dessert is a recovery gesture and is not tied to a review being changed or removed.
Only details from the public review are repeated. The business email is not personal data.
No financial, legal or staffing advice.
A business email address is fine in a Google review reply.
No argument or blame. Order details mentioned were written by the reviewer. The offer is from the approved list. No money, staff names or em-dashes. Signed off with the profile sign-off name.
